horoscopes.horoscope: Today, you will appreciate beautiful things and exotic artefacts. You may even seriously think of pursuing a business related to such commodities. However, you may not be able to make up your mind, says Ganesha. However, you will decide to keep an open mind about it. Your quest for information should create an intellectual link between you and your loved one. Rejuvenating your soul with your spouse is a great idea. You might plan a spicy evening with your loved one in the hot jacuzzi at home and indulge in complete relaxation. With your energy levels rising on this lively day, you will feel very enthusiastic. This is also the right time to re-establish contact with your childhood buddies. The motivating thoughts of your friends shall enable you to complete difficult tasks. Ganesha feels that on the financial front today you shall be aiming big and hoping for some unexpected income from some unexpected source, which will not come. Fortunately, you will not have any losses either. The codes you write for a new software will make you a star in the office today. You may feel that the logical discussions you have today have eaten up a great chunk of your time, but don’t worry, assures Ganesha, because you will gain a lot of knowledge from them.

You may find it hard to stop the impending outflow of cash while shopping today, says Ganesha. You aren’t the one to be dominated and God help anyone who tries to dictate terms to you today. You may end up spending a small fortune, more than lavish to be precise, on the opposite sex today. Today’s celestial energies have conspired to gift you the best of moments with your loved one. Ganesha wouldn’t rule out chances of a romantic dinner and a late-night visit at his or her place for coffee. You may surprise your sweetheart with a new gift. This looks set to be a very fruitful day. In the morning, you will be in high spirits and quickly finish your daily tasks. With clarity in your mind, you shall work systematically and meticulously to provide high quality output. You shall make money today from multiple sources, foresees Ganesha. Since you shall be very conscious about your financial stability and security, you shall grab all opportunities that come your way. Your confident approach will be reflected in your fluent speech today. As a result, meetings you conduct or take part in will go pretty smooth. You might manage the important tasks in the office and get hearty congratulations for a presentation well executed, feels Ganesha.

Today, you are likely to get encouragement and support for your endeavours from all quarters. You have a gift of gab and your ability to dispel tension with even the simplest of your remarks will be put to test. Still, you will rise to the occasion and prove your mettle. Taking good care of your health is important, and you are no exception. Great! Your love life is going to be extremely spontaneous. You tend to be a multi-tasker tonight to surprise your lover. While watching a romantic movie, you might be cooking with your sweetheart, dancing together or simply indulging in a laughter and fun. You will enjoy a jolly evening, foresees Ganesha. In a joyous mood, you will spread happiness and positivity everywhere you go today. With your energy levels rising, this is the right time to attend to challenging tasks. You will impress seniors and also inspire juniors in your professional sphere. On the financial front today you shall not quite be sure of yourself. You will want to increase your earnings, but will have no clue as how to go about doing it. Since you are overflowing with energy today, you will be raring to juggle many projects. Coding and decoding a software is the apt task for you. If you’ve been thinking of having some important discussions, then today’s the right day, feels Ganesha.

Today is a good day for you. However, don’t expect a windfall. It is just one of those days when you will be in a good mood, irrespective of your problems, if any. You will treat your subordinates well, and they will show their appreciation. But if you think the atmosphere at your workplace is good, wait till you reach home. Your family will be exceptionally sweet to you, and your life partner will be all over you. And the financial condition won’t be too bad either. What more can one ask for in life?. Only your sweetheart knows you deeply from the heart. Share your joys and sorrows, challenges and achievements so that your partner will steal comfort. Your beloved will prove to be the best support and will try to assuage your feelings by cuddling you in the warmth of his or her love. You will be able to memorize and remember things in a better manner today. However, you may also lose hope on certain things which could lead to frustration or depression. However, you should not allow this to happen to you. Planetary transits will move you to prepare a list of things that you want ‘now’ and you will be all set to go on shopping spree. You will not be worried about long term financial future. Urgent assignments will suffer as you will squander away your time and energy on tasks that don’t require immediate attention. Prioritising your work will help you get confident and keep you ahead of the competition. It’s natural for anyone to get annoyed in such a situation.

Everyone wants to be different. But little do they realise that they already are unique, says Ganesha. Today, you may meet a lot of such different people at work, some of whom may even test your patience. Always remember that working in a team means balancing a variety of egos and opinions. Ganesha’s advice for you today is to learn to deal with different belief systems, and not simply to look for a way to avoid conflicts. You need to take a backseat as you may like to boss your sweetheart. Be ready to listen to your lover as he or she might be having some nice ideas for a pleasurable love life tonight. You might experience a magical night. Your jolly good mood will get reflected on your health. Moreover, you will spread the positives vibes everywhere you go today. Your past efforts shall now get noticed and rewarded by your superiors. This will motivate you to achieve higher targets. Today you shall not be able to find any fault with your financial situation. You have enough funds to take care of your routine necessities, and also you will be able to save for emergencies. There is a chance today that you may try to help your colleague but fail to find a solution. You may get a chance to talk to a senior you look up to, who will hint at a possible code to solve your problem.

Take time off all by yourself and introspect today, says Ganesha. Office cubicle looks set to be a war front and pay due attention there, lest things turn to be more difficult, advises Ganesha. New love may just blossom today, and you may even enjoy a nice quiet evening with friends. Be in a compromising position with your lover today, says Ganesha. You may not solve emotional problems. You must compromise on issues that lead to an amicable solution. You need to understand the emotional condition of your spouse, suggests Ganesha. You shall remain in the pink of health on this vibrant day. Hence, you should apply your mind to think deeply and rationally about personal and professional responsibilities. Organise your daily routine and devise a better strategy to resolve complex issues. If you use your intelligence, talents and opportunities around you, you shall definitely be able to do something to earn an extra buck today. Put your marketing skills to the best use, advises Ganesha. Career is the top priority for you now. Anything that doesn’t add value to your current profile will not interest you today. However, concentrating on only one task may not help you achieve your targets of the day, foresees Ganesha.

Gear up to play the peace maker today! Your ability to handle a ‘Brady Bunch’ hasn’t gone unnoticed. So expect to be put in charge of handling disputes among your subordinates at work today, hints Ganesha. Research work may slow to a crawl today, but the offshoot is that it’s an auspicious day to enter into new contracts. You might want to arrange that bit of business over lunch. Good food has a tendency to lead to successful end of negotiations. Just don’t forget to compliment the chef and leave a tip. A delightful evening awaits you, which you will spend in the arm of your sweetheart. Ganesha ensures a wonderfully romantic time. Decorating your home with your spouse will make you happier. A romantic music post dinner will stimulate to tease your partner on the bed, feels Ganesha. The day will be lucky for you from all the angles. The day is good from the perspective of health. You will eat good food that will take your energy level up. Today you should also try to balance out unsettled areas of your life. There are more chances of seeing good progress in nearer future but today, your financial progress is likely to be restricted. Ganesha wants to draw your attention to the stocks which you already possess. Luck will be the X factor today. You cannot expect more. Planning to ask your boss for a raise. Today’s the day, says Ganesha. You will also be very active intellectually. Strategies or decision making might go your way if you practically analyse the pros and cons, foresees Ganesha.

You shall be completely immersed in your routine today. It’s the same old humbug of a day for you, says Ganesha. But this exhausting day may transform into an exciting evening – so be prepared to get surprised. A fantastic evening is on the cards tonight. Be ready to get bowled when you meet your partner today, as he or she will surprise you with either a new outfit or a chic haircut. You’ll be so enchanted you’ll follow your loved one like a puppy! The planetary positions reveal that today may be less favorable for you. Take good care of your health. Those suffering from some chronic ailments must take the necessary precautions, and senior citizens should especially go for a routine medical check-up. Dissatisfaction with your financial situation will cause you great concern today, and you are likely to feel that you are not earning nearly enough to justify the immense potential that you possess. Don’t expect fireworks in the office, at least not today, since the stars aren’t in your favor. There may be a slight build-up of tension regarding unfinished projects, but don’t bottle up frustration, says Ganesha. Plan your work properly and try to be focused. It will get done, feels Ganesha.

Your ship may be rocked by stormy controversies today. Ganesha advises you to steer clear of people looking to give you a piece of their mind. The storm looks to ease away if you lend a patient ear to all such elements, and try and accommodate their views. You might lose attention to your loved one, foresees Ganesha. Even the distance might get broader if you lose control. Be gentler and more attentive to your loved one and you will definitely reap benefits. Co-operating with your sweetheart will fetch true love that you are looking for. The day will be busy for you. Don’t be unduly influenced by what the others say about you. Also, Ganesha finds you taking more interest in convincing others. You don’t have to worry about how others feel as what you feel is more important today. Ganesha feels that this is ideal time to build social or professional contacts and create opportunities, which may help you earn in future. The time is really good for approaching organizations who can give you assignments. You might be passing stressful times at work. It’s because today’s astral configuration is coming down heavily on you. Hence, concentrating on work might be a problem today. Doing meditation or yoga daily will make you feel cool, feels Ganesha.

It’s a lucky day for your sweetheart! Wonder why it’s written in your horoscope? You will pamper him/her to the hilt, take them out on a shopping spree and buy whatever they lay their eyes on, even if it’s way beyond reasonable, says Ganesha. You will go overboard to make your love feel that nothing else matters, and although this lavish outing will serve the purpose, you may later repent not keeping a count of your cash. Remember, in the matters of the heart, it is the quality that matters, not quantity. So, enjoy few hours you spend with your sweetheart a time to remember. Respect, trust, and co-operation will help you grab attention from your loved one. Give importance to your health today. If you ignore your health at the cost of work, it could suffer. Try this not to happen. Take support from friendly people to avoid becoming negative. Eat vitamin and protein rich food to maintain good health. This is favourable day to apply for bank loans or personal loans but before you apply you should ensure that you know your exact needs. Else confusion is likely to bother you, says Ganesha. Today, you will work with an unflagging spirit to meet the deadline of an important project. Not just that, you will also encourage your colleagues to do the same. With your eyes set on the road ahead, you aren’t in any mood to go back to old projects and correct past mistakes.

Good news from across the seven seas brings cheer! If you’re seeking a visa, you may get one today. Everything looks positive and it reflects in your mood. Share your happiness with your family, says Ganesha, and you will find it multiplies manifold. After you call it a day in office, you’d want to go to the cinemas with your loved one. You can fill both of your moods with sweet and spicy flavor. There is no place like a theatre to get naughty. It’s a good day but your stomach may remain sensitive today. Avoid food that can lead to gastric troubles. You should also think less about things that you are not directly connected with. Over-thinking about others will also impact your health adversely, feels Manganese Its a good time for evaluating your material possessions. This will give you a new angle. You may even shortlist items that you have purchased recently and check how many of them are in use. You may need to learn new tools and techniques, feels Ganesha. You should join some online course, indicates your celestial reading. In fact, your astrological configuration backs a quick brush-up of your professional skills. Seek guidance from seniors in office for the same.

Conflicts galore will come your way at the workplace today. Keep a calm head over your shoulders and do keep tabs on your tongue. Differences only crop up if there are substantial thought processes involved, and keeping this in mind ought to give you the perspective needed to get ahead, says Ganesha. Be optimistic without letting anything bog you down. Savour the time you spend with your family; it’s priceless. Co-operation and not isolation will give your romance a smash hit. Break your boredom by playing the guitar or singing the most romantic number from a Bollywood movie, says Ganesha, Your priorities will be impacted hugely today due to inner conflict between heart and mind. However, Ganesha feels that you will be able to remain in good health today despite all these ups and downs. Avoid external conflicts to save energy. You may not be earning a lot on this day. But at the same time you will not spend lavishly. This will keep your bank balance in balance. You will not loose money. Not a great day for you, dear Pisceans! You’ll be in a fix not just in your personal life, but also as far as professional matters are concerned. If you are thinking of clearing all the confusion by making a to-do list, then do it today, says Ganesha.
